note: Single source for the publication gate; lib/geo/workflow.ts and scripts/verify-geo.mjs both read it. Only a record at stage "published" can create a route, a sitemap entry, an llms entry or an internal link.

fieldRules.demographicClaims: Every claim id must exist in census-claims.json and be verified:true. Tier official: value, denominator, year, definition, dataset, sourceUrl and verifiedOn all filled. Tier official-secondary (an official body citing the census, no denominator): the same without denominator plus verificationBasis and a named publication; the page text must attribute the figure to that publisher. Brief figures never qualify.
fieldRules.uniqueContentEvidence: Written evidence that this place needs its own page (distinct patient situations, travel, local sources), not a template with the city name swapped.
fieldRules.searchDemandEvidence: A dated source (Search Console export, keyword tool export) showing demand for this location-intent query. Absent demand folds the place into its region page.
fieldRules.editorialApproval: { by, on } by a Polish-speaking editor.
fieldRules.clinicalReview: { reviewer, on, approvalReference } by a clinician; reuses the gate in lib/medical-review.ts.
